_about: Hand-authored 'gold' STRIDE threat model for the bundled sample web app (samples/py_webapp). Authored by a human (Krishita Sanjay Choksi) as an expert baseline to evaluate ThreatForge's output against. Matching at eval time is by (component, stride) key. This file is reference data, not generated.

threats.note: Login accepts a password with no MFA or lockout; credential stuffing can impersonate a user.
/profile and /pay accept JSON input with no validation layer.
No audit logging of logins or payments; actions can be repudiated.
Internet-facing Flask may leak stack traces if debug is on.
No rate limiting on /login enables brute-force / flooding.
/profile/<id> has no per-object authorization; any caller can read any profile (IDOR).
No integrity controls / change auditing on the users table.
Passwords/PII stored without encryption at rest.
Unbounded writes could exhaust the store.
